Gamma multiplication expresses the two quotients as shifted-Gamma ratios; strict convexity of trigamma proves monotonicity of the density-scaled coefficient and strict concavity of log fixed-coordinate coefficient. Endpoint digamma/Gamma asymptotics and one derivative crossing prove a unique global peak. Saved finite checker passed 199 finite assertions; the proof, not the tests, establishes all-beta claims.
